q: What CBAM figure does an EU buyer need for Bahraini aluminium?
title: Bahraini aluminium: the CBAM figure
short: Direct emissions per tonne from the smelter: anode CO2, perfluorocarbons and cast house fuel. Bahrain's smelter runs on its own gas fired power, which is reported but not charged for aluminium. Ask for a verified figure per product rather than relying on default values.
audience: EU importers and extruders buying primary aluminium, billet and slab from Bahrain

ul: Anode carbon consumed in the pots.
CF4 and C2F6 from anode effects.
Bought anodes as precursors if not made on site.

p: Ingot, billet, slab and liquid metal sent to downstream plants each need their own figure. Ask which one your shipment carries.
Reported for every tonne. Buyers doing Scope 3 will add it, so ask for kWh per tonne too.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.

sources.label: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
